strengths: Books and limited physical catalogue are explicit; the store-creation and payment-to-order mechanism is concrete and sourced.
The CTA opens the actual public product-workflow page before signup; desktop/mobile have no overflow and HTML declares French.
Independent affiliate relationship and the advanced-logistics boundary remain explicit; no invented experience, earnings or tracking URL.
remaining_minor_defects: The opening and several sentences still read like a product evaluation; ordinary editorial review could shorten the email.
Cost and payment-processor fees are absent, leaving an economic question for the destination page.
The affiliation disclosure is repeated in the signature; the owned-list benefit is not the single argument chosen for this email.
judgment: Coordinator editorial review, not conversion or willingness-to-pay measurement
verdict: Usable after ordinary affiliate/brand review for a limited physical-book catalogue; not advanced fulfilment or universal ecommerce.
